maximum_depth_rule: All 225 canonical Phase 9 Reviewed statements remain raw maximum-depth records until indicators, KPIs, values, periods, units, and source-version relationships can be mapped through reviewed table-level evidence.
overlap_boundary: The six registered documents include split, full-text, and A4 versions of the basic concept and implementation plan. Their document metadata declares 233 reviewed rows, while the canonical deduplicated record set contains 225 rows; the eight-row difference is not added as new records.
evaluation_boundary: Indicators and KPIs remain separate layers. Evaluation-report achievement statuses, subsequently published actuals, corrections, and revised target years are not written over the original plan statements.
non_goals: Do not count duplicate publication formats as additional policy records.
Do not merge indicators and KPIs without reviewed definition and responsibility mapping.
Do not infer annual actuals or future targets from contents pages or mixed raw text.
Do not overwrite plan statements with later evaluations, actuals, or corrections.
Do not replace missing units or split multiple values by inference.
Do not calculate achievement, causality, or cross-prefecture ranking.
